subject: Support surcharge structure and regional escalation coverage
messages:
From: Jordan Miles <jmiles@acme.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question on regional surcharge and 24x7 escalation lanes

Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at Acme liked the latency profiles and multi-region routing. Before we loop procurement, I have one commercial question to clarify: our app requires a strict failover SLA for APAC and EMEA. I saw a line in the draft pricing referencing a "regional support surcharge" for out-of-region escalation coverage. Can you confirm:

- How that surcharge is calculated (flat per-region fee vs % of committed spend)?
- Whether it buys 24x7 pager escalation to designated engineers in those regions or only a phone-on-call window?
- Any minimum term or seat requirement to qualify for the uplifted response times?

We want to surface a single number to procurement (not multiple add-ons). Could one of your pricing leads put together a simple table showing baseline SLA tiers, the surcharge to add global on-call coverage, and the step-down credits if Acme takes Dedicated capacity?

Best,
Jordan
Procurement, Acme Corp

Attachment: example-service-matrix.xlsx (attachment stub)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jmiles@acme.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on regional surcharge and 24x7 escalation lanes

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear ask. Short answers up front: the surcharge is normally a flat regional uplift applied to the support line item (not a percentage of commit), and it includes an escalation roster with on-call handoff to engineers in the target region. The exact uplift and roster size depends on the baseline SLA tier you select (Standard / Priority / Critical).

I'll have Vanessa (who runs enterprise pricing) assemble the table you asked for. Quick Qs for scoping so we give you a single PO line:
- Do you need active monitoring/retainer (we keep a dedicated triage seat) or just guaranteed SLA + escalation (on-call only)?
- Expected peak tokens per month / committed spend (this affects Dedicated eligibility and the credit math).
- Is regional coverage required for both APAC and EMEA or start with one?

If you can reply with those bullets we’ll aim to send a one-page SKU table tomorrow.

—Kimberly
Head of Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jmiles@acme.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Support surcharge structure and regional escalation coverage — one-pager incoming

Jordan / Kimberly —

Per Kim's note, attaching a compact one-pager SKU that maps: SLA tier (Standard / Priority / Critical) -> base response windows -> regional surcharge (flat fee per region / month) -> Dedicated credit (if customer takes a Dedicated pool) -> minimum term. See attachment: one-pager-sku-surge-20270602.pdf (attachment stub).

High level summary here:
- Regional surcharge: $7,500 / region / month for Priority, $12,500 / region / month for Critical. Flat fee; includes 24x7 escalation roster and local handoff within 60 minutes for Critical.
- Dedicated credit: 35% support line item credit when a minimum dedicated commit of $150k/month is present (this reduces the regional surcharge dollar-for-dollar up to the credit cap).
- Minimum term: 12 months for Priority, 24 months for Critical to enable hired regional rosters.

I still need: expected committed spend and whether Acme wants an active retainer (we staff a named triage seat) — that changes the price by ~+$5k/month but reduces MTTI and removes per-incident triage fees.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call to walk procurement through the single-line pricing.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Enterprise Pricing, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: internal — confirm roster sizing and on-call SLAs for Acme

Internal thread —

Kim / Vanessa, quick notes from ops:
- For Critical regional coverage we provision a 3-person roster per region (rotating) to meet 60-minute local handoff and follow-up SLAs. If customer accepts a 12-month trial we can start with 2-person roster for APAC with a performance review at month 3.
- If Acme opts for the active retainer we guarantee a named triage seat during business hours for their primary region; retainer reduces incident triage fees and reduces escalation MTTI by ~40%.
- We should cap the Dedicated support credit at 50% of the regional surcharge line to avoid negative pricing with very large commits.

I'll prepare a short ops note to include with Vanessa's one-pager.

—Rishi
Head of Reliability Programs

Subject: Re: Support surcharge structure and regional escalation coverage — SKU table

Jordan / Team —

Attached is the concise SKU table you requested (one-pager-sku-surge-20270602.pdf) and a short ops FAQ. Key lines:
- Priority + APAC uplift = Base support $18,000/mo + Regional surcharge $7,500/mo = $25,500/mo.
- Critical + APAC+EMEA uplift = Base support $28,000/mo + 2 x $12,500 = $53,000/mo.
- Dedicated credit example: With a $160k/mo Dedicated commit, support credit is 35% (applied to support line), capped at 50% of the regional surcharge. In that example the net regional surcharge for Priority drops by $3,750/mo.
- Minimum terms and ramp options are listed in the PDF.

Next step: If procurement wants a single PO line we can provide a bundled SKU and SOW. If they'd prefer line items we can also produce an itemized estimate.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Enterprise Pricing, Redwood Inference
